title: Paraya Dhan
writer: S. Khalil, Ved Rahi, Sudhendu Roy
actors: Hema Malini, Rakesh Roshan, Balraj Sahni
plot: Rajjoo lives in a small village in rural India with her father Govindram. The peace in the village is shattered when a notorious thief, Hiralal, breaks out of prison and takes shelter in Govindram's house.
